methodologyNotes: Specs sourced primarily from official manufacturer spec pages (dji.com, autelpilot.com, shop.autelrobotics.com, us.hoverair.com/global.hoverair.com). Prices are US MSRP in USD for the base/drone-only or smallest bundle configuration as noted in priceNote; launch MSRP recorded where product has since been discounted. Corroboration via reputable drone journalism (dronedj.com, dronexl.co, thedronegirl.com, space.com) and Amazon listings. weight_g is the aircraft-only weight (without controller) as stated by manufacturer, in grams. camera_mp is the primary/main camera effective megapixels. max_video is the highest-resolution video mode string (resolution@fps). flight_min is manufacturer-stated max flight time in minutes (standard/single battery). range_km is the FCC-standard max transmission range in km. obstacle_sensing is a string describing sensing directions (e.g. '6-dir', '3-dir', 'downward-only'). sub250g is true if aircraft weight is under 250 g (FAA Part 48 registration threshold). release is YYYY-MM of US commercial availability. A null is used only for genuinely unknown values, never as a guess. All sources accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: DJI Mini 4 Pro
products.priceNote: US MSRP for base kit with RC-N2 controller at launch; confirmed current price 2025
products.provenance: DJI official specs page (verified 2026-06-15): weight <249 g, 1/1.3" CMOS 48 MP, 4K up to 100fps (3840x2160 at 24/25/30/48/50/60/100fps), 34 min (standard battery), 20 km FCC range, omnidirectional/6-direction obstacle sensing (forward/backward/left/right/up/down). Released September 25 2023. US price $759 base (RC-N2) confirmed via DJI store and Amazon listing.

products.name: DJI Mini 4K
products.priceNote: US launch MSRP for base kit; drone has since been discounted below $299
products.provenance: DJI specs page (shared Mini 4K / Mini 2 SE page): weight 246 g, 1/2.3" CMOS 12 MP, 4K/30fps max, 31 min flight time, 10 km FCC range (O2 system), downward vision sensor only. Launched April 29 2024 at $299 US per dronedj.com coverage.

products.name: DJI Air 3S
products.priceNote: US MSRP for base kit with RC-N3 controller (DJI Air 3S + RC-N3)
products.provenance: DJI official specs page: weight 724 g, dual camera (1" CMOS 50 MP wide + 1/1.3" 48 MP tele); primary camera MP used = 50. Max video 4K/120fps. 45 min max flight, 20 km FCC range (O4+). Omnidirectional obstacle sensing: forward LiDAR + 6 vision sensors (front/rear/bottom pairs). Released October 15 2024. US base price $1,099 confirmed via djiusa.com and dronenerds.com.

products.name: DJI Mavic 3 Pro
products.priceNote: US MSRP for base Mavic 3 Pro with DJI RC controller at launch
products.provenance: DJI official specs page: weight 958 g, triple camera (4/3" Hasselblad 20 MP primary; 1/1.3" 48 MP mid-tele; 1/2" 12 MP tele); primary camera MP = 20 (Hasselblad). Max video 5.1K (5120×2700) at 50fps. 43 min max flight, 15 km FCC range (O3+). 6-direction obstacle sensing. Released April 25 2023 at $2,199 US per official DJI announcement and dronedj.com coverage.

products.name: DJI Neo
products.priceNote: US MSRP for drone-only (no remote) at launch
products.provenance: DJI official specs page: weight ~135 g, 1/2" CMOS 12 MP, max video 4K (3840×2160) at 30fps with EIS, ~18 min flight, 10 km FCC range (O4), downward visual positioning only (no front/side/rear obstacle avoidance). Launched September 5 2024 at $199 US per thedronegirl.com launch coverage.

products.name: DJI Avata 2
products.priceNote: US MSRP for DJI Avata 2 Fly Smart Combo (single battery, with Goggles 3) — smallest purchasable bundle; drone-only not sold separately
products.provenance: DJI official specs page: weight ~377 g, 1/1.3" sensor 12 MP, 4K max at up to 100fps, ~23 min flight, 13 km FCC range, downward + rearward visual positioning (2-direction sensing). FPV drone launched April 11 2024. Smallest combo (Fly Smart, single battery) $619 per thedronegirl.com review; drone not sold standalone.

products.name: Autel EVO Lite+
products.priceNote: US current price on autelpilot.com for standard drone (sale; regular $1,549); launch MSRP was $1,549
products.provenance: autelpilot.com product page: weight 820 g takeoff, 1-inch CMOS 20 MP, 6K/30fps max video, 40 min flight, 12 km range, 3-direction obstacle sensing (forward/backward/downward binocular vision). Released January 2022. Current price $1,149 (sale) on autelpilot.com; launch MSRP was $1,549 per dpreview.com review.

products.name: Autel EVO Nano+
products.priceNote: US current price on shop.autelrobotics.com; launch MSRP was $799 in 2022
products.provenance: shop.autelrobotics.com product page: weight 249 g, 1/1.28" CMOS 50 MP (RYYB), 4K HDR/30fps, 28 min flight, 10 km tri-band transmission, forward/backward/downward obstacle avoidance. Announced September 2021, began shipping January 2022. Current US price $679; launch MSRP was $799 per dronedj.com announcement.

products.name: HOVERAir X1
products.priceNote: US current price for Combo (single battery) on global.hoverair.com; was $429 at launch in 2023
products.provenance: global.hoverair.com product page and space.com review: weight 125 g (4.4 oz), 2.7K/30fps max video (also 1080p), ~11 min flight per battery. No active transmission range spec (tethered autonomous flight within ~30m). Downward stabilization only; no multi-directional obstacle avoidance. Camera MP not officially published in specs. Launched ~August 2023 at $429; current Combo price $299 on global.hoverair.com. 32 GB internal storage. Sub-250g exempt from FAA registration.

products.name: DJI Air 3
products.priceNote: US launch MSRP for DJI Air 3 with RC-N2 controller
products.provenance: DJI official specs page: weight 720 g, dual camera (1/1.3" CMOS 48 MP wide + 1/1.3" 12 MP tele); primary camera 48 MP. 4K/60fps max video. 46 min max flight, 20 km FCC (O4). 6-direction omnidirectional obstacle sensing. Released July 2023 at $999 US. The Air 3S (2024) is successor but the Air 3 remains widely sold and compared.

products.name: DJI Mini 3 Pro
products.priceNote: US MSRP for DJI Mini 3 Pro with RC-N1 controller at launch
products.provenance: DJI Mini 3 Pro official specs: weight 249 g, 1/1.3" CMOS 48 MP, 4K/60fps max video, 34 min flight (standard battery), 12 km FCC range (O3), 3-direction obstacle sensing (forward/backward/downward). May 2023 release. Launch price $759 with RC-N1. Still widely available and compared against Mini 4 Pro.

products.name: DJI Mavic 3 Classic
products.priceNote: US MSRP for DJI Mavic 3 Classic with RC controller at launch
products.provenance: DJI official specs page: weight 895 g, 4/3" Hasselblad CMOS 20 MP, 5.1K (5280×3956)/50fps max video, 46 min max flight, 15 km FCC range (O3+), 6-direction omnidirectional obstacle sensing (APAS 5.0). Released November 2022. Launch MSRP $1,469 with RC controller per DJI.

products.name: HOVERAir X1 Pro
products.priceNote: US launch MSRP for X1 Pro (standard); X1 ProMax (8K) at $699
products.provenance: HOVERAir US product page and official comparison guide (verified 2026-06-15): X1 Pro weight 192.5 g (6.79 oz), 1/1.3" CMOS 48 MP photos, max video 4K up to 60fps (120fps only at 1080p/FHD; the 4K/120fps mode belongs to the X1 ProMax, not the Pro), 16 min flight, no published transmission range (autonomous follow mode, proximity flight), downward stabilization sensing only. Launched October 2024 at $499 MSRP; X1 ProMax (8K/30fps, 4K/120fps) at $699. Sub-250g FAA exempt.
